name: v0.3.11 — Mobile dashboard layout matches web
releaseNotes:
• Mobile dashboard layout now mirrors web exactly: feature pills → engagement strip → compact anomalies banner → 8-tile PaymentTile row → subscriptions card.
• AnomaliesCard redesigned to the same compact pink/amber single-line banner the web uses — '⚠ 3 spending anomalies · HOUSEHOLD · target · hulu' with chevron-expand + dismiss eye icon. Collapsed by default.
• TimeframeStore is now reactive — changing the time-frame on /guacwizard or any other screen propagates back to the dashboard live (ValueNotifier singleton).
• GuacWizard screen uses the shared TimeframePicker widget (Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Yearly + count dropdown) instead of its own Month/YTD/All chips.
